title: Review round 1: n1z4 JMAP multi-user INBOX
notes: Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — Three real issues found. (1) Silent mail loss: fallback smtp store deliver errors swallowed with .ok() and no log in two places in session.rs. (2) Performance: list_user_mailboxes called once per Email/query and once per Mailbox/get with no caching — O(requests) DB queries. (3) Architecture gap: smtp:{row_id} ID scheme documented only in a single doc comment; no module-level explanation of the two ID spaces and their lifecycle guarantees. The smtp<->JMAP bridge config (mail_db_path) is documented in config.rs with a clear doc comment. MailboxRights per-role constructors are explicit and maintainable. provision_user_mailboxes failure is logged as warn before proceeding — acceptable. Overall complexity is manageable for a solo maintainer with the above fixes applied.
